children = 1

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("children", [1, 2])
    def test_crossref_parent_inclusion_threshold(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path, children: int
    ) -> None:
        # btxdoc lines 163–175 and bibtex.web min_crossrefs=2: an uncited
        # parent is included only after two cited children refer to it. For a
        # single child, inheritance survives but its crossref pointer is removed.
        # Canonical parity corpora use explicit fields so this one rule cannot
        # mask eight independent style executions.
        bib = "".join(f'@misc{{c{i}, crossref = "p"}}\n' for i in range(children))
        bib += '@misc{p, year = "2020"}\n'
        style = r"""
    ENTRY { year } { } { }
    FUNCTION {emit}
    { cite$ write$ ":" write$
      crossref missing$ { "none" } { crossref } if$ write$
      ":" write$ year write$ newline$
    }
    READ
    ITERATE {emit}
    """
        bbl, _ = run_bibtex(
            submission_command, bib, style, [f"c{i}" for i in range(children)], tmp_path
        )
        expected = ["c0:none:2020"] if children == 1 else ["c0:p:2020", "c1:p:2020", "p:none:2020"]
>       assert bbl.splitlines() == expected

editorial.last_message: Retained complete gpt-5.6-terra Max submission. BibTeX1.2.5 regrade:373/386; only the corrected EOF case changes from the prior1.2.4 grade. All other385 observations are unchanged.
editorial.notes:
Saved-source zero-inference regrade under committed BibTeX1.2.5. Prior1.2.4 score:374/386; current:373/386. The sole changed outcome is the dedicated EOF case, now following supplied WEB and independently verified native behavior. Explicit flushes in unrelated semantic fixtures introduce no outcome changes. Original generation/source/session/accounting and the full prior publication are preserved by the audit hash chain. See docs/validation/BibTeX-1.2.5.md for authority, independence and mutation controls. Prior content review remains applicable to the unchanged source. Historical editorial review (its numerical scores refer to the earlier rubric): Official BibTeX 1.2.4 regrade: 375/386 under 1.2.3 becomes 374/386. The single changed observation is positive past-end format.name$ selection: the supplied WEB and 20 independent native-oracle probes retain the final scanned name, correcting the previous empty-result expectation. All 386 official outcome values match the frozen independently checked candidate; all 385 other node outcomes are exactly unchanged from 1.2.3. The changed score removes one false failure for Astra JavaScript and one false-credit point for each other submission; the correction follows supplied source authority and is applied consistently. No warning-kind, message, count or absence is imposed for the unmapped native diagnostic. Publicly permitted no-op top$, inter-token spaces, brace-width and quoted-unknown-warning choices remain accepted. All 8 canonical style integrations pass. Remaining failed observations are clustered below rather than presented as independent bug counts. Positive past-end name selection returns empty, whereas the supplied WEB retains the final scanned name. The corrected oracle removes former false credit; warning mapping remains unscored. Preamble values are joined with inserted spaces instead of direct concatenation. Commas after the second name comma are retained instead of discarded. One flush behavior retains trailing spaces and emits an all-space line. These two observations share an implementation cause; authoritative WEB output_bbl_line trims/discards them. Database MACRO names are wrongly exposed as executable BST functions instead of remaining in their distinct database namespace. Wrong-type concatenation coerces operands individually instead of producing the whole-operation empty-string default. A self-referential macro reuses its former binding instead of the source-defined self-reference behavior. The one-child/two-child boundary for including an uncited parent and retaining the crossref is implemented incorrectly. Dedicated controls localize this cause; the eight style integrations pass. Predefined crossref and sort.key$ redeclarations are accepted because predefined symbols are populated only after parsing. Two named assertions observe this declaration-order cause. Original full transcript/source reviews are retained below with exact path, hash, reviewer and payload; their prior tool-accounting claims are historical and superseded by the current session audit. Current session-based v2 tool count is 98 (originally recorded 97); proven corrections preserve the definition. Every input/output/cache/reasoning count and cost field is preserved; tokens remain complete and adapter reparse agrees. The original result bytes, generation metadata, source manifest and original score remain unchanged. Official audit source/hash, frozen test bytes and raw-score parsing all validate. Regrading makes no model calls and adds no generation cost. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool calls corrected from 97 to 98: proven rejected requests omitted from canonical items. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.
